content.text: FacebookLog InLog InForgot Account?Photographer's PostPhotographerMarch 16 at 6:37 AM · Shared with Public LANDMAN — SEASON 3 (2026) Starring: Billy Bob Thornton • Ali Larter Modern Western • Corporate Crime • Neo-Noir “Out here, power comes out of the ground.”The oil boom hasn’t slowed—it’s metastasized.As West Texas becomes a battleground of billion-dollar leases, private security, and political favors, the cost of doing business turns deadlier than ever. The land is still rich, but the margins are thinner, and mistakes are no longer forgiven.Tommy Norris finds himself caught between old-school dealmaking and a new corporate order that treats people like expendable line items. Every negotiation now comes with legal teeth, surveillance, and consequences that can’t be buried.Angela Norris refuses to remain collateral damage, carving out her own leverage in a world that underestimates her at its peril. Family, ambition, and survival collide as personal choices ripple through a system built on extraction—of oil and of people.Set against pumpjacks, backroads, and boardrooms humming with quiet menace, Landman — Season 3 sharpens its focus on moral compromise and inherited damage.Because in the end, the land doesn’t care who wins—it only remembers who took whatAll reactions:7LikeComment
